question.text: For how many years must the Structured Digital Database (SDD) maintained under Insider Trading Regulations be preserved by the AMC?

explanation.text: The Logic: The Structured Digital Database (SDD) must have audit trail, time-stamping, and preservability for 8 years (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, pp.119 and 265). AMC books and records for each scheme are also preserved for 8 years (p.266). The Trap: The 5-year retention period seen on p.172 is the PMLA-specific record-keeping rule, not the general mutual fund record-keeping period; the SDD and AMC scheme records use the 8-year rule. Note: Keep the PMLA 5-year rule and the SDD/AMC 8-year rule clearly separated by their source pages (p.172 vs pp.119 and 265-266).
